phase: ban_ke_hoach_v1 Phase 6 — Context Compaction + Memory V2
objective: Expand multi-layer memory to 8 scopes (WORKING, SESSION, PROJECT, USER, EPISODIC, SEMANTIC, PROCEDURAL, POLICY) with LearningMetadata (confidence, sample_size, evidence_refs, source_run_ids, validation_status, supersedes_id) and learning admission gates. Integrate ContextCompactor with policy preservation and Phase 5 durable checkpoints. Provide clean SQL repository persistence with CAS versioning without violating architecture boundaries.

memory_v2_contract.write_policy_gates: Secret pattern scanning; mandatory provenance_source; project_id / session_id scope isolation; learning admission gate (confidence >= 0.7, sample_size >= 3, evidence_refs non-empty for PROMOTED policy)
memory_v2_contract.superseding_lineage: Saving record with supersedes_id transitions old memory to SUPERSEDED terminal status
memory_v2_contract.ttl_policy: WORKING/SESSION/EPISODIC have default TTLs (1h/24h/30d); PROJECT/USER/SEMANTIC/PROCEDURAL/POLICY are persistent (TTL=None)

storage.migration: 0023_memory_v2 (forward-only, idempotent, creates memory_v2_records table and indexes)
storage.repository: storage/windagent_storage/repositories/memory_v2_repository.py (Async SQL CRUD, CAS versioned save_record, get_by_key, get_by_id, list_records, supersede_record, evict_expired, count_by_scope)

context_compaction_integration.compactor: context/windagent_context/compaction.py (ContextCompactor preserves critical policies, decisions, blockers, invariants; generates compaction checkpoint snapshot for Phase 5 CheckpointService)
context_compaction_integration.builder: context/windagent_context/builder.py (Prioritized memory assembly: POLICY > SEMANTIC/PROCEDURAL > WORKING/SESSION > EPISODIC with TokenBudgetManager profiles)

orchestration.service: orchestration/windagent_orchestration/long_running/memory_context_service.py (MemoryContextService coordinates Memory V2, ContextCompactor, and CheckpointService without violating architecture boundaries; 0 cross-package direct imports)

pytest_phase6.detail: 10 passed: 8 scopes CRUD, LearningMetadata validation statuses, learning admission policy checks, secret exclusion & provenance, superseding lineage, deduplication & TTL, context compaction & checkpoint integration, prompt context assembly prioritization, memory v2 repository SQL CAS durability, restart visibility & durability
